visual.title: The integral accumulates in a second plane
visual.caption: Sweep t: the vector in the right plane is the integral so far, and it returns to the origin for every analytic function. At the pole 1/z has no value, so the figure reports the crossing rather than a number.

predict.question: Traverse the unit circle backwards with 1/z. What is the integral?
predict.explain: Reversing the path reverses the sign: the integral is −2πi, not 2πi and certainly not zero.
